notes: Context: TideGate is a mid-market CS platform reselling to telco+fintech customers. Primary objective is ticket deflection and faster agent resolution using RAG. POC scope: index ~2M historical tickets + KB pages, evaluate hybrid retrieval (BM25 + ANN) then cross-encoder rerank for top-5 quality. Technical KPIs: target p50 end-to-end <200ms, p95 <350ms for front-end response (user-visible). Reranker budget: additional latency budget <=120ms; aim for top-5 precision >=0.75 after tuning. Cost sensitivity: want cost-per-query under $0.004 at expected QPS (25-50 sustained) or show clear cost playbook using Redwood Optimize (quantization + batching). Vector DB: TideGate currently evaluating Milvus vs managed FAISS; major concern is insert/index throughput for 2M docs and warm-up times. Embedding model preference: open/efficient 1536-d embeddings (they mentioned open models + Redwood catalog), but will consider managed model variants and local quantized options for dedicated. Architecture ask: bi-encoder for retrieval + cross-encoder for rerank; caching prefixes for frequent queries; HTTP streaming not needed for deflection path. Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, and EU data residency for EMEA customers. They asked explicitly: "We cannot trade top-5 accuracy for speed beyond a small delta — top-5 must be reliable." POC notes: dataset requires PII scrubbing before Redwood ingestion (customer will supply scrubbed export by 2026-03-05). SE observations: initial reranker config (cross-encoder small) gave precision@5 0.62 but p95 latency 180ms; moving reranker to dedicated GPU reduced p95 to 90-110ms but increases cost ~3x. Next steps are to test Redwood Optimize recommendations (dynamic batching, mixed-precision) and measure cost/latency tradeoffs. Stakeholders: Head of Support Ops (Ava Norton) is final decision maker; CTO (Ravi Menon) will sign off on VPC/on-prem details. Quotes: "We need deterministic latency on deflection path — customers won't wait 400ms." Action items: Jordan to send revised SOW & pricing variant for Hosted vs Dedicated by 2026-03-12; Linus to run a 2nd reranker pass with quantized weights and provide perf numbers by 2026-03-11.
